hook: 128 GB of VRAM on a tiny PC

beats.say: A homelabber hung four used 32 gigabyte Nvidia V100 cards off a tiny Lenovo M720q mini PC, for 128 gigabytes of video memory.
A PCIe switch card fans out to four OCuLink cables. A solder bridge on the riser and coreboot got past a BIOS that only booted two cards.
The build hits about 285 tokens per second in total on Qwen 3.8 27B, for roughly 3,500 dollars.
